app.name: Example Notes
app.provider: Example Notes Inc. (fictional, used for tests and mock mode)

oauth.alternatives: Personal API tokens for your own account.

appTypes.name: Public integration
appTypes.whenToUse: Your product connects many users' workspaces.

verdict.label: Self-serve, optional review
verdict.summary: Any user can connect as soon as you register. Review only matters if you want a directory listing.
verdict.nextStep: Create a public integration in the Example Notes developer portal.

composio.note: This is a fictional app, so there is no Composio toolkit for it.

stages.name: Prototype
stages.whoCanConnect: You and anyone you share the link with.

stages.name: Production
stages.notes: The wait only applies if you apply for a directory listing.

scopeTiers.name: Read pages
scopeTiers.effect: No review. Works for any user right away.

scopeTiers.name: Edit pages
scopeTiers.effect: No review. Refresh tokens are issued by default.

scopeTiers.name: Workspace admin
scopeTiers.effect: A short form review before admin scopes work outside your own workspace.

requirements.detail: Needed only for a directory listing.

steps.title: Create a public integration
steps.detail: Open the developer portal, choose New integration, pick Public, and add your redirect URI.

steps.title: Paste the client ID and secret into your auth config
steps.detail: Copy both values from the integration page into your Composio auth config or secret store.

steps.title: Draft the directory listing text
steps.detail: Use the app description draft below and edit it to match your product.

steps.title: Wait for listing review
steps.detail: Only if you applied for a listing. Your app keeps working for all users while you wait.

blockers.cause: The redirect URI in your request does not exactly match one registered on the integration.
blockers.fix: Copy the exact callback URL, including the trailing path, into the integration settings.

youMustDo: Sign in to the developer portal

drafts.title: Directory listing description
drafts.body: Example Agent reads your notes and drafts summaries. It never deletes pages.

uncertainties.question: How long does listing review take in practice?

evidence.claim: Public integrations work for any user without review.
A directory listing requires a privacy policy and a short review.
Admin scopes go through a light review.
evidence.note: The listing page mentions extra checks for admin access but gives no detail.

evidence.claim: The authorization endpoint is live and rejects an unknown client ID.
No Composio toolkit exists for a fictional app.
evidence.note: Example Notes is a test fixture.
